root.label: Flock Safety contract changes and political scrutiny

events.label: Flock Safety contract changes and political scrutiny

slots.name: Canceled city contracts
slots.sentence: More than 90 cities have deactivated, rejected or canceled Flock contracts so far this year, according to DeFlock, an advocacy group that tracks the rollout of Flock systems.

slots.name: Partnership ratio
slots.sentence: A Flock spokesperson said the company has found new city partnerships have outpaced nonrenewals by about "10 to one."
